intent: Astra review candidates, not live/included game assets

licensePolicy.defaults: deny until file SHA256, source license evidence and rig review
licensePolicy.quaterniusNotice: Publisher added QAL on 2026-08-28. Several individual source pack pages still show CC0. Freeze license + download timestamp for the exact pack; never infer cross-version permission.
licensePolicy.vroidNotice: VRM avatars have individual permission flags. Never apply default CC0; verify the file's VRM meta and user's upload rights.

sources.title: Universal Base Characters
sources.notes: 6 base proportions and 20 hairstyles; strong candidate for a SECOND, stylized character family, not direct replacement of the approved Victoria/Fumiriya VRMs.

sources.title: Modular Character Outfits Fantasy
sources.notes: 12 outfits, 62 swappable rigged parts, 3 colorways; same rig family as Universal Base Characters; 280MB Standard; gate mesh clipping, body compatibility and texture licenses.

sources.title: Universal Animation Library
sources.notes: 120+ motion clips; rig names and root motion changed in 2026. Retarget to VRM separately, choose in-place locomotion for network prediction.

sources.title: Universal Animation Library 2
sources.notes: Additional parkour/combat/farming/zombie motions. Free Standard vs paid Source differences must be recorded.

sources.title: Ultimate Modular Women
sources.notes: 10 characters, four swappable parts, 24 animations. Different family from Universal Base Characters; prefer NPCs or separate avatar set.

sources.title: Ultimate Modular Men
sources.notes: 11 characters, four swappable parts, 24 animations. Do not mix components with Victoria/Fumiriya VRMs without explicit retarget.

sources.title: KayKit Character Animations
sources.notes: CC0 animation rigs suited to KayKit characters; verify current free tier before importing.

sources.title: KayKit Adventurers Official GitHub
sources.notes: Open-source distributor repository with rigged characters, motions and accessories. Could be NPC/adventure world pack, NOT native VRM clothing.

sources.title: KayKit Skeletons Official GitHub
sources.notes: Skeleton NPC/encounter set, 90+ animation clips, accessory props; preserve original rights record.

sources.title: Kenney Animated Characters 3
sources.notes: CC0 rigged characters with human/zombie skins, idle/run/jump. Animation rig family not compatible with VRM by default.

sources.title: Downtown City MegaKit
sources.notes: 315 modular urban structures/streets in pack index; cozy urban plazas and town-building, reuse common atlas, validate pivots/colliders.

sources.title: Medieval Village MegaKit
sources.notes: 300+ modular grid-snap village elements, doors, stairs and buildings; Stage for player creator themed worlds.

sources.title: Stylized Nature MegaKit
sources.notes: 116 trees/plants/rocks from older CC0 pack. Optimize alpha foliage and LOD before mobile rollout.

sources.title: KayKit City Builder Bits Official GitHub
sources.notes: 32+ city props, gradient atlas 1024; direct GitHub source available. Check actual downloaded archive contains complete GLTF texture/bin references.

sources.title: KayKit Dungeon Remastered Official GitHub
sources.notes: 200+ stylized dungeon pieces; can support player-created quests without external LLM.

sources.title: KayKit City Builder Bits Creator Page
sources.notes: Reference page for pack version and free-vs-extra split; prefer direct official GitHub repo for reproducible source.

sources.title: Poly Haven CC0 Models
sources.notes: High-fidelity object and environment decor. Download selected files only; heavy meshes and textures need mobile reductions.

sources.title: Poly Haven HDRIs
sources.notes: Bake/convert optional skies to small compressed environment maps; no live API dependency for end-user builder.

sources.title: ambientCG PBR Materials
sources.notes: CC0 material library; select texture sets by target world quality tier, convert to KTX2. Confirm license from publisher before import.

sources.title: Kenney UI Pack
sources.notes: 400+ CC0 icons and components; use only pieces consistent with CTRL's editorial design.

sources.title: VRoid Hub / Creator Avatars (per model permission)
sources.notes: NOT blanket CC0. Require explicit avatar use, corporate/commercial use, modifications, redistribution and creator/user consent from each asset's VRM1 meta before hosting.

sources.title: Adobe Mixamo Motion Retargeting (not redistributed)
sources.notes: Can use in complete game subject to Adobe terms; do NOT mirror or sell individual/raw animation files. Source remains optional; account needed.

sources.title: VRM Game Starter Retarget/Foot IK Reference
sources.notes: MIT source code reference for retargeting, foot IK, and character swap; its bundled avatars/animations have distinct licenses. DO NOT replace Astra Habitat controller.
